# Atote Labs

> Startup studio based in Nairobi, Kenya. Building the next generation of software products.

Website: https://atote-labs.pages.dev
Built by: Kristian Hans Onjala (https://kristianhans.com)

---

## What is Atote Labs?

Atote Labs is a startup studio based in Nairobi, Kenya, dedicated to building the next generation of software products that make a lasting impact. Unlike traditional companies that focus on a single product, Atote Labs operates as a studio — exploring multiple opportunities simultaneously, validating ideas rapidly, and scaling successful ventures while maintaining lean operations.

Each venture created by Atote Labs is built with the same core principles: exceptional quality, user focus, and sustainable scalability. The studio leverages shared resources, knowledge, and infrastructure across all its products, allowing it to move quickly while maintaining high standards.

---

## Pages on This Website

- [Home](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/): Landing page introducing Atote Labs as a startup studio with mission statement and featured ventures.
- [Ventures](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/ventures): Portfolio of products and startups built by Atote Labs, including Venturely, Scrapifie, and other active projects.
- [About](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/about): Full company story — the studio model, vision, philosophy (quality over speed, user-centric design, innovation through iteration, sustainable growth), and Nairobi base.
- [Insights](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/insights): Articles and thought pieces on technology, startups, and the African tech ecosystem.
- [Insight Article](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/insights/:slug): Individual insight article page with full content, publish date, author, and related articles.
- [Contact](https://atote-labs.pages.dev/contact): Reach out for partnerships, collaboration, investment, or general inquiries.

---

## Company Philosophy

- **Quality Over Speed**: Prioritizing robust, well-architected solutions over rushing to market with half-baked products.
- **User-Centric Design**: Every decision guided by the needs and experiences of users.
- **Innovation Through Iteration**: Continuous improvement through data-driven learning and product evolution.
- **Sustainable Growth**: Building businesses designed to last with sustainable models and long-term thinking.

---

## Ventures Built by Atote Labs

1. **Venturely** — Market intelligence platform tracking 20,000+ startups globally with AI-powered signal detection, verified cap tables, and interactive research. [venturely.kristianhans.com](https://venturely.kristianhans.com)
2. **Scrapifie** — Enterprise-grade web scraping platform with TLS fingerprinting, CAPTCHA solving, anti-detection, and distributed job queues. [scrapifie.kristianhans.com](https://scrapifie.kristianhans.com)

## Technical Information

- **Stack**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma
- **Design**: Light/dark theme toggle, responsive mobile-first design, professional minimalist aesthetic
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages (frontend)
- **Built by**: Kristian Hans Onjala
